description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE L (k LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY); Close; DBEngine.SetOption(dbImplicitCommitSync, "Yes"); OpenDatabase shared read/write. L(k LONG primary key) with keys 1200..1 inserted descending, one INSERT each (r-q7 long-split-descending). The full pages 44, 48, 49, 50, 51 are read after the inserts of keys 800, 799, 599, 598, 298, 297 (the statements before and at the root's rewrite and the two splits), and pages 44-53 after Close. Asks where each split falls and what each page holds at it.
retentionNote: r-q17-growth round 2: per-statement split pages under dbImplicitCommitSync Yes, and the repeat of lval-memo (stamp variation)
